faqs.a:
The authority shall, at least once a year, file with the mayor a report of its activities
               for the preceding year and shall make any recommendations with reference to any additional
               legislation or other action that may be necessary in order to carry out the purposes
               of this article.
(Code 1981, § 14-44; Ord. No. 1248, § 26, 6-16-1975)
State Law reference—
Similar provisions, C.R.S. § 29-4-228.
